name: app.R
content:
# r4lineups app. Modules live in R/, which Shiny sources automatically.

library(shiny)
# In the browser (Shinylive/webR) the webR repository carries an old r4lineups,
# so the current version is installed from r-universe.
if (identical(R.version$os, "emscripten") &&
    (!requireNamespace("r4lineups", quietly = TRUE) ||
     utils::packageVersion("r4lineups") < "2.3.0")) {
  webr::install("r4lineups", repos = c("https://cgtza2.r-universe.dev", "https://repo.r-wasm.org"))
}
library(r4lineups)

ui <- bslib::page_navbar(
  title = "r4lineups",
  id = "nav",
  theme = bslib::bs_theme(version = 5, primary = "#2c5d8a"),
  fillable = FALSE,
  bslib::nav_panel("Home", icon = icon("house"), home_ui("home")),
  bslib::nav_panel("Data", icon = icon("table"), data_ui("data")),
  bslib::nav_menu(
    "Lineup fairness",
    bslib::nav_panel("Bias & size", fairness_ui("fairness")),
    bslib::nav_panel("Diagnosticity", diagnosticity_ui("diag"))
  ),
  bslib::nav_panel("Multi-d'", multid_ui("multid")),
  bslib::nav_panel("ROC & CAC", roc_ui("roc")),
  bslib::nav_panel("Calibration & decision", calibration_ui("calibration")),
  bslib::nav_panel("EIG & PPV", eig_ui("eig")),
  bslib::nav_panel("Bayesian", bayes_ui("bayes")),
  if (face_tab_available()) bslib::nav_panel("Face similarity", face_ui("face")),
  bslib::nav_spacer(),
  bslib::nav_item(tags$a(icon("book"), "Docs", href = docs_url, target = "_blank"))
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  home_server("home")
  data <- data_server("data")
  fairness_server("fairness")
  diagnosticity_server("diag")
  multid_server("multid", data)
  roc_server("roc", data)
  calibration_server("calibration", data)
  eig_server("eig", data)
  bayes_server("bayes", data)
  if (face_tab_available()) face_server("face")
}

shinyApp(ui, server)

name: R/mod_bayes.R
content:
# Bayesian posteriors for effective size, functional size, diagnosticity,
# calibration and SDT comparisons.

bayes_ui <- function(id) {
  ns <- NS(id)
  sdt_inputs <- function(g, vals) {
    bslib::layout_columns(
      col_widths = c(6, 6),
      numericInput(ns(paste0("hits_", g)), "Hits", vals[1], min = 0),
      numericInput(ns(paste0("misses_", g)), "Misses", vals[2], min = 0),
      numericInput(ns(paste0("fas_", g)), "False alarms", vals[3], min = 0),
      numericInput(ns(paste0("crs_", g)), "Correct rejections", vals[4], min = 0)
    )
  }
  bslib::layout_sidebar(
    sidebar = bslib::sidebar(
      width = 360,
      selectInput(ns("analysis"), "Analysis", choices = c(
        "Effective size E'" = "esize", "Functional size" = "func",
        "Diagnosticity ratio" = "diag", "Calibration (Data tab)" = "calibration",
        "SDT d' comparison" = "sdt"
      )),
      conditionalPanel(
        sprintf("input['%s'] == 'esize' || input['%s'] == 'func'", ns("analysis"), ns("analysis")),
        lineup_input_ui(ns("lineup"))
      ),
      conditionalPanel(
        sprintf("input['%s'] == 'diag'", ns("analysis")),
        textAreaInput(ns("diag_tp"), "Target-present choices", rows = 3),
        textAreaInput(ns("diag_ta"), "Target-absent choices", rows = 3),
        bslib::layout_columns(
          col_widths = c(6, 6),
          numericInput(ns("diag_pos_tp"), "TP suspect position", 3, min = 1),
          numericInput(ns("diag_pos_ta"), "TA suspect position", 3, min = 1),
          numericInput(ns("diag_k_tp"), "TP lineup size", 8, min = 2),
          numericInput(ns("diag_k_ta"), "TA lineup size", 8, min = 2)
        ),
        actionLink(ns("diag_example"), "Load example (nortje2012 lineups 1 and 2)")
      ),
      conditionalPanel(
        sprintf("input['%s'] == 'calibration'", ns("analysis")),
        uiOutput(ns("banner")),
        checkboxInput(ns("choosers"), "Choosers only", value = TRUE),
        selectInput(ns("cal_metric"), "Plot", choices = c("C", "OU", "NRI"))
      ),
      conditionalPanel(
        sprintf("input['%s'] == 'sdt'", ns("analysis")),
        textInput(ns("label_A"), "Condition A", "A"),
        sdt_inputs("A", c(45, 55, 12, 88)),
        textInput(ns("label_B"), "Condition B", "B"),
        sdt_inputs("B", c(38, 62, 10, 90))
      ),
      tags$hr(),
      bslib::layout_columns(
        numericInput(ns("alpha"), "Dirichlet/Beta prior", 0.5, min = 0.01, step = 0.1),
        numericInput(ns("S"), "Posterior draws", 5000, min = 500, step = 500)
      ),
      bslib::layout_columns(
        numericInput(ns("threshold"), "Threshold t (optional)", NA),
        numericInput(ns("seed"), "Seed", 2026, step = 1)
      ),
      helpText("With a threshold, the summary reports P(statistic < t) and P(statistic > t)."),
      run_button(ns("run"))
    ),
    uiOutput(ns("notes")),
    table_card(ns, "summary", "Posterior summary"),
    plot_card(ns, "plot", "Posterior distribution"),
    table_card(ns, "draws", "Posterior draws (first 1,000)")
  )
}

bayes_server <- function(id, data) {
  moduleServer(id, function(input, output, session) {
    lineup <- lineup_input_server("lineup")
    output$banner <- renderUI(data_banner(data()))

    observeEvent(input$diag_example, {
      updateTextAreaInput(session, "diag_tp", value = paste(r4lineups::nortje2012$lineup_1, collapse = ", "))
      updateTextAreaInput(session, "diag_ta", value = paste(r4lineups::nortje2012$lineup_2, collapse = ", "))
    })

    threshold <- reactive(if (is.na(input$threshold %||% NA)) NULL else input$threshold)
    probs <- function(res) {
      tp <- res$threshold_probs
      c(P_below_t = if (is.null(tp)) NA_real_ else tp$P_below,
        P_above_t = if (is.null(tp)) NA_real_ else tp$P_above)
    }
    interval <- function(res) {
      c(ci_lower = unname(res$credible_interval["lower"]),
        ci_upper = unname(res$credible_interval["upper"]))
    }

    result <- reactive({
      a <- input$alpha
      S <- as.integer(input$S)
      set.seed(input$seed)
      run <- capture_notes(switch(
        input$analysis,
        esize = {
          L <- lineup()
          res <- r4lineups::esize_T_bayes(L$tab, alpha = a, S = S, threshold = threshold())
          list(summary = data.frame(statistic = "E'", n = res$n, k = res$k,
                                    posterior_mean = res$posterior_mean,
                                    posterior_median = res$posterior_median,
                                    t(interval(res)), t(probs(res))),
               draws = data.frame(E_prime = res$E_draws), plot = plot(res))
        },
        func = {
          L <- lineup()
          validate(need(!is.na(L$target), "Enter the suspect position."))
          res <- r4lineups::func_size_bayes(L$vec, target_pos = L$target, alpha = a, S = S,
                                            threshold = threshold())
          list(summary = data.frame(statistic = "Functional size", n = res$n,
                                    suspect_ids = res$n_suspect,
                                    posterior_mean = res$posterior_mean,
                                    posterior_median = res$posterior_median,
                                    t(interval(res)), t(probs(res))),
               draws = data.frame(functional_size = res$F_draws), plot = plot(res))
        },
        diag = {
          tp <- parse_numeric_vector(input$diag_tp)
          ta <- parse_numeric_vector(input$diag_ta)
          validate(need(length(tp) > 0 && length(ta) > 0, "Enter TP and TA choices, or load the example."))
          res <- r4lineups::diag_ratio_T_bayes(tp, ta, pos_pres = input$diag_pos_tp,
                                               pos_abs = input$diag_pos_ta, k1 = input$diag_k_tp,
                                               k2 = input$diag_k_ta, alpha = a, S = S,
                                               threshold = threshold())
          list(summary = data.frame(statistic = "Diagnosticity ratio", n_tp = res$n_tp,
                                    n_ta = res$n_ta, posterior_mean = res$posterior_mean,
                                    posterior_median = res$posterior_median,
                                    t(interval(res)), t(probs(res))),
               draws = data.frame(DR = res$DR_draws, lnDR = res$lnDR_draws), plot = plot(res))
        },
        calibration = {
          d <- data()
          res <- r4lineups::calibration_bayes(d$data, confidence_bins = d$bins,
                                              choosers_only = isTRUE(input$choosers),
                                              lineup_size = d$lineup_size,
                                              innocent_suspect = d$innocent_suspect, alpha = a, S = S)
          stat_row <- function(m) {
            data.frame(statistic = m, posterior_mean = res[[paste0(m, "_mean")]],
                       posterior_median = res[[paste0(m, "_median")]],
                       ci_lower = unname(res[[paste0(m, "_ci")]]["lower"]),
                       ci_upper = unname(res[[paste0(m, "_ci")]]["upper"]))
          }
          list(summary = do.call(rbind, lapply(c("C", "OU", "NRI"), stat_row)),
               draws = data.frame(C = res$C_draws, OU = res$OU_draws, NRI = res$NRI_draws),
               plot = plot(res, metric = input$cal_metric))
        },
        sdt = {
          res <- r4lineups::sdt_compare(
            hits_A = input$hits_A, misses_A = input$misses_A, fas_A = input$fas_A, crs_A = input$crs_A,
            hits_B = input$hits_B, misses_B = input$misses_B, fas_B = input$fas_B, crs_B = input$crs_B,
            label_A = input$label_A, label_B = input$label_B, alpha = a, S = S
          )
          list(summary = data.frame(statistic = "d'(A) - d'(B)",
                                    dprime_A_mean = res$dprime_A_mean, dprime_B_mean = res$dprime_B_mean,
                                    posterior_mean = res$posterior_mean,
                                    posterior_median = res$posterior_median, t(interval(res)),
                                    P_A_greater = res$P_A_greater),
               draws = data.frame(dprime_A = res$dprime_A_draws, dprime_B = res$dprime_B_draws,
                                  delta_dprime = res$delta_dprime_draws),
               plot = plot(res))
        }
      ))
      c(run$value, list(notes = run$notes))
    }) |>
      bindEvent(input$run, ignoreNULL = FALSE)

    output$notes <- renderUI(notes_ui(result()$notes))
    serve_table(output, "summary", function() result()$summary, "bayes_summary.csv")
    serve_plot(output, "plot", function() result()$plot, "bayes_posterior.png")
    output$draws <- DT::renderDT(dt_table(utils::head(result()$draws, 1000)))
    output$draws_csv <- downloadHandler(
      filename = function() paste0("bayes_", input$analysis, "_draws.csv"),
      content = function(file) utils::write.csv(result()$draws, file, row.names = FALSE)
    )

    result
  })
}

# Expected information gain (Starns et al.) and PPV ranges (Fitzgerald et al.).

eig_ui <- function(id) {
  ns <- NS(id)
  bslib::layout_sidebar(
    sidebar = bslib::sidebar(
      width = 300,
      uiOutput(ns("banner")),
      sliderInput(ns("prior"), "Prior probability of guilt", min = 0.05, max = 0.95,
                  value = 0.5, step = 0.05),
      run_button(ns("run"))
    ),
    uiOutput(ns("notes")),
    bslib::layout_column_wrap(
      width = 1 / 4, fill = FALSE,
      bslib::value_box("Expected information gain", textOutput(ns("vb_eig")), theme = "primary"),
      bslib::value_box("PPV (nominal size)", textOutput(ns("vb_ppv_nom")), theme = "light"),
      bslib::value_box("PPV (effective size)", textOutput(ns("vb_ppv_eff")), theme = "light"),
      bslib::value_box("PPV (no correction)", textOutput(ns("vb_ppv_none")), theme = "light")
    ),
    bslib::navset_card_underline(
      id = ns("tabs"),
      bslib::nav_panel(
        "Information gain",
        bslib::layout_columns(
          col_widths = c(6, 6),
          plot_card(ns, "eig_plot", "Information gain by response"),
          plot_card(ns, "eig_post", "Posterior probability of guilt")
        ),
        table_card(ns, "eig_table", "Responses")
      ),
      bslib::nav_panel(
        "PPV range",
        bslib::layout_columns(
          col_widths = c(6, 6),
          plot_card(ns, "ppv_plot", "PPV by confidence"),
          plot_card(ns, "ppv_eff", "Effective size by confidence")
        ),
        table_card(ns, "ppv_table", "PPV range by confidence")
      )
    )
  )
}

eig_server <- function(id, data) {
  moduleServer(id, function(input, output, session) {
    output$banner <- renderUI(data_banner(data()))

    result <- reactive({
      d <- data()
      run <- capture_notes(list(
        eig = r4lineups::make_eig(d$data, prior_guilt = input$prior, confidence_bins = d$bins,
                                  show_plot = FALSE, lineup_size = d$lineup_size,
                                  innocent_suspect = d$innocent_suspect),
        ppv = r4lineups::make_ppv_range(d$data, lineup_size = d$lineup_size,
                                        innocent_suspect = d$innocent_suspect,
                                        confidence_bins = d$bins, show_plots = FALSE)
      ))
      c(run$value, list(notes = run$notes))
    }) |>
      bindEvent(input$run, data(), ignoreNULL = FALSE)

    output$notes <- renderUI(notes_ui(result()$notes))
    output$vb_eig <- renderText(fmt_num(result()$eig$eig))
    output$vb_ppv_nom <- renderText(fmt_num(result()$ppv$ppv_nominal$overall_ppv))
    output$vb_ppv_eff <- renderText(fmt_num(result()$ppv$ppv_effective$overall_ppv))
    output$vb_ppv_none <- renderText(fmt_num(result()$ppv$ppv_none$overall_ppv))

    serve_plot(output, "eig_plot", function() r4lineups::plot_eig(result()$eig), "eig.png")
    serve_plot(output, "eig_post", function() r4lineups::plot_eig_posteriors(result()$eig),
               "eig_posteriors.png")
    serve_table(output, "eig_table", function() result()$eig$response_data, "eig_responses.csv")
    serve_plot(output, "ppv_plot", function() r4lineups::plot_ppv_range(result()$ppv), "ppv_range.png")
    serve_plot(output, "ppv_eff", function() r4lineups::plot_effective_size_conf(result()$ppv),
               "ppv_effective_size.png")
    serve_table(output, "ppv_table", function() result()$ppv$ppv_range_data, "ppv_range.csv")

    result
  })
}

# Lineup fairness from mock-witness choices: bias, effective size and
# functional size for one lineup.

fairness_ui <- function(id) {
  ns <- NS(id)
  bslib::layout_sidebar(
    sidebar = bslib::sidebar(
      width = 330,
      lineup_input_ui(ns("lineup")),
      tags$hr(),
      bslib::layout_columns(
        numericInput(ns("R"), "Bootstrap R", value = 1000, min = 100, step = 100),
        numericInput(ns("seed"), "Seed", value = 2026, step = 1)
      ),
      checkboxInput(ns("unbiased"), "Small-sample corrected E' (unbiased sum of p squared)", value = FALSE),
      helpText("Plug-in E' is biased downward with few mock witnesses; the corrected form uses",
               "N(N-1) / sum o(o-1). See \"E' is biased downward in small samples\" in the core vignette."),
      run_button(ns("run"))
    ),
    uiOutput(ns("notes")),
    bslib::layout_column_wrap(
      width = 1 / 3, fill = FALSE,
      bslib::value_box("Suspect proportion", textOutput(ns("vb_prop")),
                       textOutput(ns("vb_prop_ci")), theme = "primary"),
      bslib::value_box("Effective size E'", textOutput(ns("vb_esize")),
                       textOutput(ns("vb_esize_ci")), theme = "light"),
      bslib::value_box("Functional size", textOutput(ns("vb_func")),
                       textOutput(ns("vb_func_ci")), theme = "light")
    ),
    bslib::navset_card_underline(
      id = ns("tabs"),
      bslib::nav_panel(
        "Lineup bias",
        bslib::layout_columns(
          col_widths = c(6, 6),
          plot_card(ns, "prop_plot", "Proportion choosing each member"),
          table_card(ns, "prop_table", "Member proportions (* = suspect)")
        ),
        bslib::layout_columns(
          col_widths = c(6, 6),
          plot_card(ns, "bias_dist", "Bootstrap distribution of the suspect proportion"),
          table_card(ns, "bias_tests", "Suspect proportion against chance (1/k)")
        )
      ),
      bslib::nav_panel(
        "Effective size",
        bslib::layout_columns(
          col_widths = c(6, 6),
          plot_card(ns, "esize_dist", "Bootstrap distribution of E'"),
          table_card(ns, "esize_table", "Effective size estimates")
        )
      ),
      bslib::nav_panel(
        "Functional size",
        table_card(ns, "func_table", "Functional size (N / suspect choices)")
      )
    )
  )
}

fairness_server <- function(id) {
  moduleServer(id, function(input, output, session) {
    lineup <- lineup_input_server("lineup")

    result <- reactive({
      L <- lineup()
      validate(need(!is.na(L$target), "Enter the suspect position."))
      R <- as.integer(input$R)
      set.seed(input$seed)
      unbiased <- isTRUE(input$unbiased)
      run <- capture_notes({
        # The corrected E' and its bootstrap come first, so that the latter
        # can be reproduced from the seed alone
        corrected <- if (unbiased) r4lineups::esize_T(L$tab, unbiased = TRUE)
        corrected_boot <- if (unbiased) {
          r4lineups::esize_boot_dist(L$vec, L$k, metric = "tredoux", R = R, unbiased = TRUE)
        }
        props <- r4lineups::allprop(L$vec, L$k)
        prop_ci <- r4lineups::lineup_boot_allprop(L$vec, L$k, R = R)
        bias_boot <- r4lineups::lineup_bias_boot_dist(L$vec, L$target, L$k, R = R)
        plugin <- r4lineups::esize_T(L$tab)
        esize_normal <- r4lineups::esize_T_ci_n(L$tab, 0.95)
        esize_boot <- r4lineups::esize_boot_dist(L$vec, L$k, metric = "tredoux", R = R)
        malpass <- r4lineups::esize_m(L$tab, L$k)
        malpass_boot <- r4lineups::esize_boot_dist(L$vec, L$k, metric = "malpass", R = R)
        func <- tryCatch(r4lineups::func_size_report(L$vec, L$target, L$k, R = R),
                         error = function(e) {
                           warning("Functional size: ", conditionMessage(e), call. = FALSE)
                           NULL
                         })
        # esize and esize_boot are the estimator shown in the value box and
        # distribution plot: the corrected one when it is requested
        list(props = props, prop_ci = prop_ci, bias_boot = bias_boot,
             esize = if (unbiased) corrected else plugin,
             esize_boot = if (unbiased) corrected_boot else esize_boot,
             plugin = plugin, plugin_boot = esize_boot, esize_normal = esize_normal,
             unbiased = unbiased, malpass = malpass, malpass_boot = malpass_boot,
             func = func)
      })
      c(run$value, list(notes = run$notes, L = L))
    }) |>
      bindEvent(input$run, ignoreNULL = FALSE)

    output$notes <- renderUI(notes_ui(result()$notes))

    suspect_count <- reactive(as.integer(result()$L$tab[result()$L$target]))

    output$vb_prop <- renderText(fmt_num(result()$props$prop[result()$L$target]))
    output$vb_prop_ci <- renderText({
      r <- result()
      sprintf("95%% CI %s · chance %s",
              fmt_ci(stats::quantile(r$bias_boot, c(0.025, 0.975))), fmt_num(1 / r$L$k))
    })
    output$vb_esize <- renderText(fmt_num(result()$esize, 2))
    output$vb_esize_ci <- renderText({
      r <- result()
      sprintf("95%% CI %s · k = %d",
              fmt_ci(stats::quantile(r$esize_boot, c(0.025, 0.975)), 2), r$L$k)
    })
    output$vb_func <- renderText({
      f <- result()$func
      if (is.null(f)) "—" else fmt_num(f$estimate, 2)
    })
    output$vb_func_ci <- renderText({
      f <- result()$func
      if (is.null(f)) "No suspect choices" else sprintf("95%% CI %s (percentile)", fmt_ci(f$percentile, 2))
    })

    prop_df <- reactive({
      r <- result()
      data.frame(
        position = ifelse(seq_len(r$L$k) == r$L$target, paste0(seq_len(r$L$k), "*"),
                          as.character(seq_len(r$L$k))),
        count = as.integer(r$L$tab),
        proportion = r$props$prop,
        ci_low = r$prop_ci$ci_low,
        ci_high = r$prop_ci$ci_high
      )
    })

    serve_table(output, "prop_table", prop_df, "member_proportions.csv")
    serve_plot(output, "prop_plot", function() {
      df <- prop_df()
      df$member <- factor(seq_len(nrow(df)))
      df$suspect <- grepl("*", df$position, fixed = TRUE)
      ggplot2::ggplot(df, ggplot2::aes(member, proportion, fill = suspect)) +
        ggplot2::geom_col(width = 0.7) +
        ggplot2::geom_errorbar(ggplot2::aes(ymin = ci_low, ymax = ci_high), width = 0.2) +
        ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = 1 / result()$L$k, linetype = "dashed") +
        ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = "#9aa9b8", `TRUE` = "#2c5d8a"),
                                   labels = c("Filler", "Suspect"), name = NULL) +
        ggplot2::labs(x = "Lineup position", y = "Proportion of mock witnesses",
                      caption = "Dashed line: chance (1/k)\nError bars: 95% bootstrap intervals") +
        ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
        ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "top")
    }, "member_proportions.png")

    bias_tests <- reactive({
      r <- result()
      bt <- stats::binom.test(suspect_count(), r$L$n, p = 1 / r$L$k, alternative = "greater")
      ci_exact <- stats::binom.test(suspect_count(), r$L$n)$conf.int
      data.frame(
        quantity = c("Suspect choices", "Mock witnesses", "Suspect proportion", "Chance (1/k)",
                     "Exact 95% CI", "Bootstrap 95% CI", "Binomial p (proportion > chance)"),
        value = c(suspect_count(), r$L$n, fmt_num(suspect_count() / r$L$n), fmt_num(1 / r$L$k),
                  fmt_ci(ci_exact), fmt_ci(stats::quantile(r$bias_boot, c(0.025, 0.975))),
                  format.pval(bt$p.value, digits = 3))
      )
    })
    serve_table(output, "bias_tests", bias_tests, "suspect_bias.csv")
    serve_plot(output, "bias_dist", function() {
      r4lineups::plot_lineup_bias_distribution(result()$bias_boot, target_pos = result()$L$target)
    }, "suspect_bias_distribution.png")

    esize_df <- reactive({
      r <- result()
      boot_ci <- function(x) fmt_ci(stats::quantile(x, c(0.025, 0.975)))
      plugin_rows <- data.frame(
        measure = c(if (r$unbiased) "E' (Tredoux, 1998), plug-in" else "E' (Tredoux, 1998)",
                    "E' plug-in normal-theory 95% CI", "E' plug-in bootstrap 95% CI"),
        value = c(fmt_num(r$plugin, 3), fmt_ci(c(r$esize_normal$ci_low, r$esize_normal$ci_high)),
                  boot_ci(r$plugin_boot))
      )
      corrected_rows <- if (r$unbiased) {
        data.frame(measure = c("E' (Tredoux, 1998), small-sample corrected",
                               "E' corrected bootstrap 95% CI"),
                   value = c(fmt_num(r$esize, 3), boot_ci(r$esize_boot)))
      }
      rbind(
        corrected_rows,
        plugin_rows,
        data.frame(measure = c("Effective size (Malpass, 1981; Tredoux adjustment)",
                               "Malpass bootstrap 95% CI", "Nominal size k"),
                   value = c(fmt_num(r$malpass, 3), boot_ci(r$malpass_boot), r$L$k))
      )
    })
    serve_table(output, "esize_table", esize_df, "effective_size.csv")
    serve_plot(output, "esize_dist", function() {
      r4lineups::plot_esize_distribution(
        result()$esize_boot,
        metric = if (result()$unbiased) "E' (Tredoux), corrected" else "E' (Tredoux)"
      )
    }, "effective_size_distribution.png")

    func_df <- reactive({
      f <- result()$func
      validate(need(!is.null(f), "Functional size is undefined when nobody chooses the suspect."))
      data.frame(
        quantity = c("Functional size", "Normal-theory 95% CI", "Bootstrap percentile 95% CI",
                     "Bootstrap BCa 95% CI", "Exact (Clopper-Pearson) 95% CI", "Bootstrap R",
                     "Bootstrap samples with no suspect choices"),
        value = c(fmt_num(f$estimate, 3), fmt_ci(f$normal), fmt_ci(f$percentile), fmt_ci(f$bca),
                  fmt_ci(f$exact), f$R, f$n_infinite)
      )
    })
    serve_table(output, "func_table", func_df, "functional_size.csv")

    result
  })
}

# Diagnosticity ratios for one or more target-present / target-absent pairs,
# with a homogeneity test when there are several pairs.

# Three pairs from the core vignette: the suspect (position 1) is chosen less
# often in TP and more often in TA lineups from pair to pair.
diag_example <- function() {
  choose_pos1 <- function(n1) c(rep(1, n1), rep(2:6, length.out = 100 - n1))
  lines <- function(x) paste(vapply(x, paste, character(1), collapse = ", "), collapse = "\n")
  list(tp = lines(lapply(c(60, 45, 32), choose_pos1)),
       ta = lines(lapply(c(10, 15, 20), choose_pos1)))
}

diagnosticity_ui <- function(id) {
  ns <- NS(id)
  bslib::layout_sidebar(
    sidebar = bslib::sidebar(
      width = 360,
      textAreaInput(ns("tp"), "Target-present lineups (one per line)", rows = 4,
                    value = diag_example()$tp),
      textAreaInput(ns("ta"), "Target-absent lineups (one per line, same order)", rows = 4,
                    value = diag_example()$ta),
      textInput(ns("pos"), "Suspect position per pair", value = "1"),
      textInput(ns("k"), "Lineup size per pair", value = "6"),
      helpText("Give one value to use it for every pair."),
      actionLink(ns("example"), "Load example (three pairs, from the vignette)"),
      tags$hr(),
      bslib::layout_columns(
        numericInput(ns("R"), "Bootstrap R", value = 500, min = 50, step = 50),
        numericInput(ns("seed"), "Seed", value = 2026, step = 1)
      ),
      checkboxInput(ns("boot"), "Bootstrap the homogeneity test", value = FALSE),
      run_button(ns("run"))
    ),
    uiOutput(ns("notes")),
    table_card(ns, "pairs", "Diagnosticity ratio for each pair"),
    table_card(ns, "homog", "Homogeneity of diagnosticity ratios (Tredoux, 1998)")
  )
}

diagnosticity_server <- function(id) {
  moduleServer(id, function(input, output, session) {
    observeEvent(input$example, {
      updateTextAreaInput(session, "tp", value = diag_example()$tp)
      updateTextAreaInput(session, "ta", value = diag_example()$ta)
      updateTextInput(session, "pos", value = "1")
      updateTextInput(session, "k", value = "6")
    })

    result <- reactive({
      tp <- parse_lines(input$tp)
      ta <- parse_lines(input$ta)
      validate(need(length(tp) > 0, "Enter target-present lineups, or load the example."),
               need(length(tp) == length(ta), "Enter the same number of TP and TA lineups."))
      n <- length(tp)
      pos <- rep_len(parse_numeric_vector(input$pos), n)
      k <- rep_len(parse_numeric_vector(input$k), n)
      validate(need(length(pos) == n && length(k) == n, "Give a suspect position and lineup size."))
      set.seed(input$seed)
      run <- capture_notes({
        pairs <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(n), function(i) {
          data.frame(
            pair = i, n_tp = length(tp[[i]]), n_ta = length(ta[[i]]),
            suspect_ids_tp = sum(tp[[i]] == pos[i]), suspect_ids_ta = sum(ta[[i]] == pos[i]),
            dr_wells_lindsay = r4lineups::diag_ratio_W(tp[[i]], ta[[i]], pos[i], pos[i], k[i], k[i]),
            dr_tredoux = r4lineups::diag_ratio_T(tp[[i]], ta[[i]], pos[i], pos[i], k[i], k[i])
          )
        }))
        homog <- NULL
        if (n >= 2) {
          homog <- if (isTRUE(input$boot)) {
            r4lineups::homog_diag_boot(tp, ta, k = k, R = as.integer(input$R), pos_list = pos,
                                       seed = input$seed)
          } else {
            r4lineups::homog_diag(tp, ta, pos, k)
          }
        }
        list(pairs = pairs, homog = homog)
      })
      pair_ci <- run$value$homog$parameters
      if (!is.null(pair_ci)) {
        run$value$pairs$dr_ci_lower <- pair_ci$lower
        run$value$pairs$dr_ci_upper <- pair_ci$upper
      }
      c(run$value, list(notes = run$notes))
    }) |>
      bindEvent(input$run, ignoreNULL = FALSE)

    output$notes <- renderUI(notes_ui(result()$notes))
    serve_table(output, "pairs", function() result()$pairs, "diagnosticity_pairs.csv")
    serve_table(output, "homog", function() {
      h <- result()$homog
      validate(need(!is.null(h), "The homogeneity test needs at least two lineup pairs."))
      data.frame(
        quantity = c("Mean diagnosticity ratio", "Chi-square (Q)", "df", "p",
                     "Heterogeneous", if (!is.null(h$mean_ci)) "Bootstrap CI for mean"),
        value = c(fmt_num(h$mean_diagnosticity), fmt_num(h$chi_square), h$df,
                  format.pval(h$p_value, digits = 3), h$heterogeneous,
                  if (!is.null(h$mean_ci)) fmt_ci(h$mean_ci))
      )
    }, "diagnosticity_homogeneity.csv")

    result
  })
}

# Home: what the app covers, data formats, version and citation.

docs_url <- "https://cgtza2.github.io/r4lineups/"

home_ui <- function(id) {
  ns <- NS(id)
  article <- function(file, label) tags$a(href = paste0(docs_url, "articles/", file, ".html"),
                                          target = "_blank", label)
  bslib::layout_columns(
    col_widths = c(6, 6),
    bslib::card(
      bslib::card_header("r4lineups"),
      tags$p(
        "Interactive analyses of eyewitness lineups. Every number shown here is computed by an exported ",
        "function of the r4lineups package, named on each tab, so results can be reproduced in R."
      ),
      tags$h6("Mock-witness data (a vector of chosen positions, or counts per position)"),
      tags$ul(
        tags$li(tags$strong("Lineup fairness: "), "suspect bias against chance, member proportions, ",
                "effective size (Tredoux's E', Malpass), functional size, and diagnosticity ratios ",
                "with a homogeneity test. ", article("Vignette", "Vignette")),
        tags$li(tags$strong("Bayesian: "), "posterior distributions for E', functional size, ",
                "diagnosticity, calibration and SDT comparisons. ", article("bayesian_inference", "Vignette"))
      ),
      tags$h6("Witness data with confidence (load on the Data tab)"),
      tags$ul(
        tags$li(tags$strong("Multi-d': "), "Lee and Penrod's (2019) signal detection indices, including ",
                "d'(IFa) as a resultant measure of lineup bias. ", article("multid_model", "Vignette")),
        tags$li(tags$strong("ROC & CAC: "), "partial ROC, CAC, full ROC and pAUC comparison. ",
                article("fullroc_analysis", "Vignette")),
        tags$li(tags$strong("Calibration & decision: "), "calibration, ANRI, DPP, expected utility, ",
                "Bayesian curves, BREE and RAC. ", article("calibration_decision_analysis", "Vignette")),
        tags$li(tags$strong("EIG & PPV: "), "expected information gain and PPV ranges. ",
                article("information_error_rate_analysis", "Vignette"))
      ),
      if (face_tab_available()) tags$p(
        tags$strong("Face similarity "), "(local only) compares face images with deepface embeddings."
      ),
      tags$p(
        "Analyses run when you click ", tags$em("Run analysis"),
        "; tabs that use the Data tab also rerun when the data change. Tables and plots can be downloaded."
      )
    ),
    bslib::card(
      bslib::card_header("About"),
      tags$p("Package version ", textOutput(ns("version"), inline = TRUE)),
      tags$p(tags$a(href = docs_url, target = "_blank", "Documentation"), " · ",
             tags$a(href = "https://github.com/CGTZA2/r4lineups", target = "_blank", "Source"), " · ",
             tags$a(href = "https://github.com/CGTZA2/r4lineups/issues", target = "_blank", "Report a problem")),
      tags$h6("Citation"),
      uiOutput(ns("citation")),
      tags$h6("Run locally"),
      tags$pre("install.packages(\"r4lineups\")\nr4lineups::run_r4lineups_app()"),
      if (is_webr()) tags$p(class = "small text-muted",
                            "This copy runs entirely in your browser: data you load are not sent to a server.")
    )
  )
}

home_server <- function(id) {
  moduleServer(id, function(input, output, session) {
    output$version <- renderText(as.character(utils::packageVersion("r4lineups")))
    output$citation <- renderUI({
      cit <- tryCatch({
        file <- system.file("CITATION", package = "r4lineups")
        format(utils::readCitationFile(file, meta = list(Encoding = "UTF-8")), style = "html")
      }, error = function(e) character())
      tagList(lapply(cit, function(x) tags$p(class = "small", HTML(x))))
    })
  })
}

# ROC, CAC and full ROC, with a pAUC comparison when two groups are chosen.

roc_ui <- function(id) {
  ns <- NS(id)
  bslib::layout_sidebar(
    sidebar = bslib::sidebar(
      width = 320,
      uiOutput(ns("banner")),
      selectInput(ns("order"), "Full ROC category order",
                  choices = c("A priori (for inference)" = "apriori",
                              "By diagnosticity" = "diagnosticity")),
      bslib::layout_columns(
        numericInput(ns("n_boot"), "pAUC bootstrap R", value = 1000, min = 100, step = 100),
        numericInput(ns("seed"), "Seed", value = 2026, step = 1)
      ),
      helpText("The pAUC comparison runs when two groups are chosen on the Data tab."),
      run_button(ns("run"))
    ),
    uiOutput(ns("notes")),
    uiOutput(ns("scope")),
    bslib::layout_column_wrap(
      width = 1 / 3, fill = FALSE,
      bslib::value_box("Partial AUC", textOutput(ns("vb_pauc")), theme = "primary"),
      bslib::value_box("CAC: overall suspect-ID accuracy", textOutput(ns("vb_cac")), theme = "light"),
      bslib::value_box("Full ROC AUC", textOutput(ns("vb_auc")), theme = "light")
    ),
    bslib::navset_card_underline(
      id = ns("tabs"),
      bslib::nav_panel(
        "ROC",
        bslib::layout_columns(
          col_widths = c(6, 6),
          plot_card(ns, "roc_plot", "ROC (suspect identifications)"),
          table_card(ns, "roc_table", "ROC points")
        ),
        table_card(ns, "pauc_table", "pAUC comparison")
      ),
      bslib::nav_panel(
        "CAC",
        bslib::layout_columns(
          col_widths = c(6, 6),
          plot_card(ns, "cac_plot", "Confidence-accuracy characteristic"),
          table_card(ns, "cac_table", "CAC by confidence bin")
        )
      ),
      bslib::nav_panel(
        "Full ROC",
        bslib::layout_columns(
          col_widths = c(6, 6),
          plot_card(ns, "fullroc_plot", "Full ROC (Smith & Yang, 2020)"),
          table_card(ns, "fullroc_table", "Full ROC categories")
        )
      )
    )
  )
}

roc_server <- function(id, data) {
  moduleServer(id, function(input, output, session) {
    output$banner <- renderUI(data_banner(data()))

    result <- reactive({
      d <- data()
      df <- d$data
      run <- capture_notes({
        roc <- r4lineups::make_rocdata(df, lineup_size = d$lineup_size,
                                       innocent_suspect = d$innocent_suspect)
        cac <- r4lineups::make_cacdata(df, lineup_size = d$lineup_size,
                                       innocent_suspect = d$innocent_suspect, confidence_bins = d$bins)
        fullroc <- r4lineups::make_fullroc_data(df, conf_bins = d$bins, order = input$order,
                                                lineup_size = d$lineup_size,
                                                innocent_suspect = d$innocent_suspect)
        pauc <- if (!is.null(d$groups)) {
          r4lineups::compare_pauc(d$groups$data[[1]], d$groups$data[[2]],
                                  lineup_size = d$lineup_size,
                                  innocent_suspect = d$innocent_suspect,
                                  n_bootstrap = as.integer(input$n_boot), seed = input$seed,
                                  label1 = d$groups$labels[1], label2 = d$groups$labels[2])
        }
        list(roc = roc, cac = cac, fullroc = fullroc, pauc = pauc)
      })
      c(run$value, list(notes = run$notes))
    }) |>
      bindEvent(input$run, data(), ignoreNULL = FALSE)

    output$notes <- renderUI(notes_ui(result()$notes))
    output$scope <- renderUI(group_scope_note(data(), paste(
      "The ROC plot and pAUC table compare the groups;",
      "the summary boxes, CAC and full ROC use all rows.")))
    output$vb_pauc <- renderText(fmt_num(result()$roc$pauc, 4))
    output$vb_cac <- renderText(fmt_num(result()$cac$overall_accuracy))
    output$vb_auc <- renderText(fmt_num(result()$fullroc$auc))

    serve_plot(output, "roc_plot", function() {
      r <- result()
      if (is.null(r$pauc)) {
        return(r4lineups::make_roc_gg(r$roc))
      }
      pts <- rbind(cbind(group = r$pauc$label1, r$pauc$roc1$roc_data),
                   cbind(group = r$pauc$label2, r$pauc$roc2$roc_data))
      ggplot2::ggplot(pts, ggplot2::aes(false_id_rate, correct_id_rate, colour = group)) +
        ggplot2::geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
        ggplot2::geom_point(size = 2.5) +
        ggplot2::geom_vline(xintercept = r$pauc$max_false_id_rate, linetype = "dotted") +
        ggplot2::geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
        ggplot2::coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, max(pts$false_id_rate) * 1.1), ylim = c(0, 1)) +
        ggplot2::labs(x = "False ID rate (innocent suspect)", y = "Correct ID rate (guilty suspect)",
                      colour = NULL, caption = "Dotted line: pAUC cut-off.") +
        ggplot2::theme_bw(base_size = 13)
    }, "roc.png")
    serve_table(output, "roc_table", function() result()$roc$roc_data, "roc_points.csv")
    serve_table(output, "pauc_table", function() {
      p <- result()$pauc
      validate(need(!is.null(p), "Choose two groups on the Data tab to compare pAUC."))
      data.frame(
        quantity = c(paste("pAUC", p$label1), paste("pAUC", p$label2), "Difference",
                     "SE of difference", sprintf("%d%% CI of difference", round(100 * p$conf_level)),
                     "z", "p", "False ID cut-off", "Bootstrap R"),
        value = c(fmt_num(p$pauc1, 4), fmt_num(p$pauc2, 4), fmt_num(p$pauc_diff, 4),
                  fmt_num(p$se_diff, 4), fmt_ci(p$ci_diff, 4), fmt_num(p$z_score),
                  format.pval(p$p_value, digits = 3), fmt_num(p$max_false_id_rate), p$n_bootstrap)
      )
    }, "pauc_comparison.csv")

    serve_plot(output, "cac_plot", function() r4lineups::make_cac_gg(result()$cac), "cac.png")
    serve_table(output, "cac_table", function() result()$cac$cac_data, "cac.csv")
    serve_plot(output, "fullroc_plot", function() r4lineups::plot_fullroc(result()$fullroc),
               "full_roc.png")
    serve_table(output, "fullroc_table", function() result()$fullroc$diagnosticity_table,
                "full_roc_categories.csv")

    result
  })
}
